civilopediaText.text: A newly assimilated host, still half-human in shape but already listening to a voice from beneath the waves. It fights without fear, because it no longer has anything left to lose.
Years of assimilation have shaped this host further - its weapon arm has fused with something that was never a sword to begin with, but cuts like one all the same.

name: Brood Hull
uniques: Never appears as a Barbarian unit

civilopediaText.text: Not built so much as grown - a living hull of coral, chitin, and something that used to be a ship's crew, propelled by dozens of half-formed limbs beneath the waterline.
Grown larger and bolder now that it no longer needs to hide close to shore, this hull ranges across open ocean freely, dragging captured surface vessels down to add to its shape.

A hollow, discarded carapace reanimated and driven forward by something that no longer needs it to breathe. It skitters across open ground faster than anything with legs has a right to, striking hard before vanishing back toward the tideline.
A larger shell, ridden by nothing at all - the carapace itself has become the predator, charging on legs of bone and calcified muscle that were once something else's armor.
